http_method
Description
Specifies the action of the HTTP request. Common values are
GET
and
POST
. This command is a BIG-IP version 4.X variable, provided
for backward-compatibility. You can use the equivalent 9.Xcommand
HTTP::method
instead.
Syntax
http_method
http_method
Specifies the action of the HTTP request. Common values are

and ‘’’POST*.
